title: feat(nsqpx): nsopp x-probe PVM letter: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Same PVM construction on nsopp x-probes: n(A)=(-1/3,-1/3,0) k=2, n(B)=n(C)=(-1/3,0,0) k=1, n(D)=(-1/3,1/3,0) k=2, with Tr(rho P_+)=2/3 and Tr(rho P_-)=1/3 at k=1 for rho = (I + n.sigma)/2. Same vacuity as #7161 - the 'fail' branch of the scored predicate is dead code - so the informative content is the kernel values and the 2/3 : 1/3 Born-shaped weights, not the verdict pair.
